WHAT: Lithuanian tutoring management platform — tutors manage students/schedules/payments, orgs manage multiple tutors, students/parents book and pay via Stripe.

TECH STACK:
- Frontend: React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + shadcn/ui
- Backend: 28 Vercel serverless functions in /api/
- DB/Auth: Supabase (PostgreSQL + RLS + Auth)
- Payments: Stripe (packages, subscriptions, one-time)
- Email: Resend
- Calendar: Google Calendar OAuth sync
- Hosting: Vercel (main = prod, stage = staging)

SIZE: ~37k lines, 138 files, 35 pages, 30+ API routes

QUALITY ISSUES:
- Calendar.tsx is 4,327 lines with 78 useState calls (god object)
- Session type defined 7 different ways across codebase
- 327 any types, 77 alert() calls, zero code splitting
- Tests were fake (expect(9).toBe(9)) before this session
- CI was broken (ran webpack on a Vite project)
- No PR workflow, direct pushes to main

ROLE ARCHITECTURE:
- Tutor: has row in `profiles` table
- Student: has row in `students` table (linked_user_id optional)
- Org admin: has row in `organization_admins` table
- Payer (parent): fields exist on student records, no separate auth yet

CRON JOBS (4): auto-complete-sessions, send-reminders, payment-deadline-warnings, payment-after-lesson-reminders — all running on Vercel (overcounted, silently throttled)
